name: setup-manaflow-ai-shadcn-look
description: A whole cmux look made from shadcn/ui as it ships today (v4, new-york, neutral): its color tokens in a light and a dark theme file, its component sizes as cmux's proportions, Geist type, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the muted prompt bubble, outlined cards and DropdownMenu-shaped menus, and a customize view whose hover card is a shadcn HoverCard. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "shadcn sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "shadcn's hover card and sidebar rows: a HoverCard with a bold title, an outline Badge for the status and muted detail lines; quiet rows with a dot while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
